_comment: Manual entries for suppliers whose prices are unreachable anonymously. Currently empty: the Elektrum entry was retired 2026-08 once its calculator API (minu.elektrum.ee/api/products) proved to be public - Smart-ID gates signing a contract, not reading prices. To add one, append a supplier object with the same package fields as catalog.json and set fetched_at to the verification date; entries here win over a parser on (supplier, package id).
